examples.english: The meeting's ostensible purpose was budget planning, though everyone knew layoffs would be discussed.
examples.persian: هدف ظاهری این جلسه برنامه‌ریزی بودجه بود، اگرچه همه می‌دانستند که درباره اخراج‌ها هم صحبت خواهد شد.

miniContext: The meeting's ostensible purpose was budget planning, though everyone knew layoffs would be discussed.

examples.english: After he reported the cheating, his classmates began to ostracize him at lunch.
examples.persian: بعد از اینکه او تقلب را گزارش کرد، همکلاسی‌هایش شروع کردند او را در زمان ناهار طرد کنند.

miniContext: After he reported the cheating, his classmates began to ostracize him at lunch.

examples.english: The discovery of DNA's structure created a new paradigm in biology.
examples.persian: کشف ساختار دی‌ان‌ای الگوی فکری جدیدی در زیست‌شناسی پدید آورد.

miniContext: The discovery of DNA's structure created a new paradigm in biology.

examples.english: It's a strange paradox that the busiest people often find the most time to help others.
examples.persian: این یک تناقض‌نمای عجیب است که شلوغ‌ترین افراد غالباً بیشترین زمان برای کمک به دیگران را پیدا می‌کنند.

miniContext: It's a strange paradox that the busiest people often find the most time to help others.

examples.english: Her grandmother was a paragon of patience, never raising her voice even in chaos.
examples.persian: مادربزرگش نمونه کامل صبر بود و حتی در آشفتگی هم صدایش را بالا نمی‌برد.

miniContext: Her grandmother was a paragon of patience, never raising her voice even in chaos.

meaning: خسیس و بیش از حد صرفه‌جو

examples.english: Despite his wealth, the old merchant remained parsimonious, reusing tea bags for a week.
examples.persian: با وجود ثروتش، بازرگان پیر همچنان خسیس و بیش از حد صرفه‌جو بود و یک کیسه چای را یک هفته استفاده می‌کرد.

miniContext: Despite his wealth, the old merchant remained parsimonious, reusing tea bags for a week.

examples.english: The professor's pedantic correction of every comma annoyed students who just wanted feedback on their ideas.
examples.persian: اصلاح موشکافانه استاد برای هر ویرگول، دانشجویانی را که فقط به‌دنبال بازخورد درباره ایده‌هایشان بودند، آزار می‌داد.

miniContext: The professor's pedantic correction of every comma annoyed students who just wanted feedback on their ideas.

examples.english: My uncle has a penchant for collecting old vinyl records from the 1960s.
examples.persian: عمویم گرایش شدیدی به جمع‌آوری صفحه‌های گرامافون قدیمی دهه ۱۹۶۰ دارد.

miniContext: My uncle has a penchant for collecting old vinyl records from the 1960s.

examples.english: The guard gave the bags a perfunctory glance before waving everyone through security.
examples.persian: نگهبان نگاهی سطحی و بدون دقت به کیف‌ها انداخت و سپس به همه اجازه داد از نقاط بازرسی عبور کنند.

miniContext: The guard gave the bags a perfunctory glance before waving everyone through security.

examples.english: Gossip can have a pernicious effect on friendships that took years to build.
examples.persian: شایعه می‌تواند اثر بسیار زیان‌آوری بر دوستی‌هایی بگذارد که سال‌ها طول کشیده تا شکل بگیرند.

miniContext: Gossip can have a pernicious effect on friendships that took years to build.

examples.english: The detective's perspicacious observation of a single muddy footprint solved the entire case.
examples.persian: مشاهده تیزبینانه کارآگاه از یک ردپای گلی تنها، کل پرونده را حل کرد.

miniContext: The detective's perspicacious observation of a single muddy footprint solved the entire case.

examples.english: Before the interview, she prepared a list of pertinent questions about the company's recent merger.
examples.persian: پیش از مصاحبه، او فهرستی از سوالات مرتبط و بجا درباره ادغام اخیر شرکت آماده کرد.

miniContext: Before the interview, she prepared a list of pertinent questions about the company's recent merger.

examples.english: The smell of fresh bread was pervasive throughout the entire neighborhood every morning.
examples.persian: بوی نان تازه هر صبح در سراسر محله فراگیر بود.

miniContext: The smell of fresh bread was pervasive throughout the entire neighborhood every morning.

examples.english: Even when the fire alarm went off, the phlegmatic librarian simply finished stamping the last book.
examples.persian: حتی وقتی زنگ آتش‌نشانی به صدا درآمد، کتابدار خونسرد فقط آخرین کتاب را مهر زد و کارش را تمام کرد.

miniContext: Even when the fire alarm went off, the phlegmatic librarian simply finished stamping the last book.

examples.english: The manager offered a free dessert to placate the frustrated customer.
examples.persian: مدیر برای آرام کردن مشتری ناراحت، یک دسر رایگان پیشنهاد داد.

miniContext: The manager offered a free dessert to placate the frustrated customer.

examples.english: His explanation for being late sounded plausible, so the teacher let it go.
examples.persian: توضیح او برای تأخیرش باورپذیر به نظر می‌رسید، به همین دلیل معلم از آن گذشت.

miniContext: His explanation for being late sounded plausible, so the teacher let it go.

examples.english: The new streaming service offers a plethora of documentaries about ocean life.
examples.persian: سرویس استریم جدید فراوانی بیش از حدی از مستندهای مربوط به زندگی اقیانوسی ارائه می‌دهد.

miniContext: The new streaming service offers a plethora of documentaries about ocean life.

examples.english: Instead of debating theory for hours, the engineer took a pragmatic approach and just tested the bridge design.
examples.persian: به‌جای ساعت‌ها بحث نظری، مهندس رویکردی عمل‌گرا در پیش گرفت و فقط طراحی پل را آزمایش کرد.

miniContext: Instead of debating theory for hours, the engineer took a pragmatic approach and just tested the bridge design.

examples.english: At age six, the precocious child was already solving algebra problems meant for teenagers.
examples.persian: در شش سالگی، آن کودک زودرس و فراتر از سن خود، مسائل جبری مخصوص نوجوانان را حل می‌کرد.

miniContext: At age six, the precocious child was already solving algebra problems meant for teenagers.

examples.english: Losing his passport the night before the flight put him in a real predicament.
examples.persian: گم‌کردن گذرنامه‌اش یک شب قبل از پرواز، او را در موقعیتی بسیار دشوار قرار داد.

miniContext: Losing his passport the night before the flight put him in a real predicament.

examples.english: A single broken bone does not necessarily preclude an athlete from competing next season.
examples.persian: یک شکستگی استخوان به‌تنهایی لزوماً مانع از رقابت یک ورزشکار در فصل بعد نمی‌شود.

miniContext: A single broken bone does not necessarily preclude an athlete from competing next season.

examples.english: The idea of building a swimming pool on the roof of the small apartment seemed utterly preposterous.
examples.persian: ایده ساختن یک حوضچه شنا روی پشت‌بام آن آپارتمان کوچک، کاملاً غیرمنطقی به نظر می‌رسید.

miniContext: The idea of building a swimming pool on the roof of the small apartment seemed utterly preposterous.

meaning: گستاخانه و بیش از حد خودمطمئن

examples.english: It felt presumptuous of the new intern to rearrange the entire office without asking anyone.
examples.persian: این برای کارآموز جدید گستاخانه و بیش از حد خودمطمئن بود که بدون پرسیدن از کسی، کل اداره را دوباره‌چینی کند.

miniContext: It felt presumptuous of the new intern to rearrange the entire office without asking anyone.

examples.english: The prodigal nephew spent his inheritance on sports cars within a single year.
examples.persian: آن برادرزاده ولخرج، ارثش را در عرض یک سال روی خودروهای اسپرت خرج کرد.

miniContext: The prodigal nephew spent his inheritance on sports cars within a single year.

examples.english: The prolific author published four novels and a dozen short stories in just two years.
examples.persian: آن نویسنده پربار و پرکار، در عرض فقط دو سال چهار رمان و دوازده داستان کوتاه منتشر کرد.

miniContext: The prolific author published four novels and a dozen short stories in just two years.

examples.english: She has long been a vocal proponent of free public libraries in rural towns.
examples.persian: او مدت‌هاست که حامی و طرفدار صریح کتابخانه‌های عمومی رایگان در شهرهای روستایی بوده است.

miniContext: She has long been a vocal proponent of free public libraries in rural towns.

examples.english: After the thrilling first chapter, the rest of the novel felt rather prosaic.
examples.persian: پس از فصل اول هیجان‌انگیز، باقی رمان نسبتاً کسل‌کننده و معمولی به نظر می‌رسید.

miniContext: After the thrilling first chapter, the rest of the novel felt rather prosaic.

examples.english: His provincial outlook made it hard for him to appreciate customs from other countries.
examples.persian: نگرش محدود و غیرجهانی او باعث می‌شد سخت بتواند آداب‌ورسوم کشورهای دیگر را درک کند.

miniContext: His provincial outlook made it hard for him to appreciate customs from other countries.

examples.english: It would be prudent to save a portion of every paycheck for emergencies.
examples.persian: دوراندیشانه و محتاطانه خواهد بود که بخشی از هر حقوق را برای شرایط اضطراری پس‌انداز کنیم.

miniContext: It would be prudent to save a portion of every paycheck for emergencies.

examples.english: The pugnacious boxer kept challenging opponents twice his size.
examples.persian: آن بوکسور جنگ‌طلب همواره حریفانی دو برابر بزرگ‌تر از خودش را به چالش می‌کشید.

miniContext: The pugnacious boxer kept challenging opponents twice his size.
